title: Enable MCP access for new workflows via env variable
text: The idea is: Create a new environment variable N8N_MCP_AUTO_EXPOSE_NEW_WORKFLOWS to enable the option “MCP access for new workflows” as code. My use case: I have multiple n8n instances so I don’t want to configure it manually on all instances. I think it would be beneficial to add this because: Env-managed instances become consistent: every MCP setting locked in the UI can be set from the environment. Any resources to support this? packages/@n8n/config/src/configs/instance-settings-loader.config.ts ( N8N_MCP_MANAGED_BY_ENV , N8N_MCP_ACCESS_ENABLED ) packages/cli/src/instance-settings-loader/loaders/mcp-settings.loader.ts packages/cli/src/modules/mcp/mcp.settings.controller.ts (env-managed guard) Are you willing to work on this? Yes I can open a PR. 1 post - 1 participant Read full topic

title: Loophole for abuse on shopify collabs
text: I noticed a Collabs order where someone used a creator code, bought 6 items, and returned 5. The customer’s discount adjusted on the refund, but the creator’s payout is still based on the full original order. Right now, I cannot open a dispute once a payment is scheduled - and even when I can, disputes cover the whole commission, not just the returned portion. That leaves us with a lose-lose choice: pay commission on returned items, or wipe out the creator’s entire commission on a partial return. It also leaves room for abuse. Someone could place a $1,000 order and return $975 worth of items. With a 10% commission, the creator still gets $100 on just $25 in sales, and the store loses $75. Shopify - I am urging you to adjust Collabs commissions automatically when refunds happen instead of making merchants file full disputes on partial returns. 10 posts - 5 participants Read full topic
author: Mary_Spinelli
triage_reason: Shopify Collabs creates commission payout losses on partial returns.

title: Réforme de la facturation électronique en France
text: Bonjour à tous, Est-ce que quelqu’un a des informations concernant la réforme de la facturation électronique sur Shopify ? À partir de septembre 2027, les entreprises seront tenues d’envoyer leurs factures clients B2B via des plateformes agréées. Afin d’automatiser ce processus, il est nécessaire de récupérer le numéro de SIRET de la société. Or, à ce jour, il est impossible d’ajouter un numéro de SIRET dans le checkout Shopify. Savez-vous si Shopify prévoit une mise à jour de cette fonctionnalité pour répondre aux exigences de la réglementation française ? Merci pour vos retours. Paul 1 post - 1 participant Read full topic
author: Paul0017
triage_reason: Shopify checkout lacks SIRET field required for French B2B e-invoicing.
